summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Production Module Iteration 49 revisions: (1) Daily Production Report with spreadsheet-style auto-save, (2) Merged Masterlist into Daily Report page as a second tab, (3) SO Masuk with Qty Total column and Mulai Kerja/Batal Mulai buttons. All backend APIs working correctly (16/16 tests passed). Frontend integration working well with one minor UX issue (Enter key focus navigation).

minor_ux_issues.issue: Enter key navigation: After pressing Enter in a cell, the row is saved correctly but focus may not move to the next row same column as expected. The auto-save functionality itself works perfectly.
minor_ux_issues.workaround: Users can click or tab to the next cell. The core auto-save feature works correctly.

Backend: POST /production/reports - auto-save create report
Backend: GET /production/reports?date= - list reports for specific date with totals
